global-actions.source: Foreign-regulator actions matched to this device family by word-bounded brand terms with per-row corroboration signals (manufacturer match, distinctive brand, multi-brand co-occurrence); corroborated matches shown, screened matches counted. Sources: Health Canada MedEffect, MHRA UK FSN, Swissmedic FSCA, TGA DRAC, Medsafe NZ, ICIJ IMDD (historic), EUDAMED (EU registrations).
global-actions.caveat: Foreign action classifications are jurisdiction-specific (Canada Type I = most serious; TGA hazard Class I = lowest). The ICIJ layer is a historic journalistic compilation (largely pre-2020); current-source coverage runs through mid-2026. TGA rows are reproduced for research/evaluation; commercial redistribution of TGA DRAC content requires TGA permission.
